root: ^TO SELECT AN ITEM, USE THE 123 KEYS. YOU CAN ALSO USE THE SCROLL WHEEL OR JUST CLICK ON THE ITEM.
^PRESS SPACE TO USE THE SELECTED ITEM.
^YOU CAN USE THE BOOK TO TEAR PAGES AND MAKE PAPER BALLS. IT'S A BIG BOOK, SO YOU CAN TEAR AS MANY PAGES AS YOU WANT.
^BUT BE CAREFUL, TEACHERS MIGHT HEAR YOU TEARING PAGES.
^TO THROW A BALL, SELECT IT AND PRESS SPACE.
^AFTER THAT, MOVE THE MOUSE TO SELECT WHERE YOU WANT TO THROW IT AND THEN USE LEFT CLICK TO THROW.
